name: codestar-notifications
description: This AWS CodeStar Notifications API Reference provides descriptions and usage examples of the operations and data types for the AWS CodeStar Notifications API.

subcommands.name: create-notification-rule
subcommands.description: Creates a notification rule for a resource.

options.name: --name
options.description: The name for the notification rule.

options.name: --event-type-ids
options.description: A list of event types associated with this notification rule.

options.name: --resource
options.description: The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the resource to associate with the notification rule.

options.name: --targets
options.description: A list of Amazon Resource Names (ARNs) of Amazon Simple Notification Service topics and Chatbot clients to associate with the notification rule

options.name: --detail-type
options.description: The level of detail to include in the notifications for this resource.

options.name: --client-request-token
options.description: A unique, client-generated idempotency token that, when provided in a request, ensures the request cannot be repeated with a changed parameter.

options.name: --tags
options.description: A list of tags to apply to this notification rule.

options.name: --status
options.description: The status of the notification rule.

options.name: --cli-input-json
options.description: Performs service operation based on the JSON string provided.

options.name: --generate-cli-skeleton
options.description: Prints a JSON skeleton to standard output without sending an API request.

subcommands.description: Creates an association between a notification rule and an Chatbot topic or Chatbot client so that the associated target can receive notifications when the events described in the rule are triggered

options.name: --target

options.name: --client-request-token
options.description: An enumeration token that, when provided in a request, returns the next batch of the results
